title: Simulation 3D Pedestrian
text: Implement pedestrian in 3D environment, 3 inputs, 2 outputs, {Type} sets Type of pedestrian Male; {Scale}, {Initial position [X, Y, Z] (m)} sets the initial pedestrian position, {Initial yaw (deg)} sets the initial angle of pedestrian rotation, {Name}, {Sample time} and {Output location (m) and orientation (rad)} sets the output location and orientation. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Yaw
ports.summary: Yaw orientation angle of pedestrian scalar

params.name: Type
params.values: Type of pedestrian Male 1 (default) | Male 2 | Male 3 | Female 1 | Female 2 | Female 3 | Child

params.name: Scale
params.values: Scale factor for pedestrian [1, 1, 1] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector

params.name: Initial yaw (deg)
params.values: Initial angle of pedestrian rotation 0 (default) | real-valued scalar

params.name: Name
params.values: Name of pedestrian SimulinkPedestrian1 (default) | pedestrian name

params.name: Output location (m) and orientation (rad)
params.values: Output location and orientation of pedestrian off (default) | on
